notes: Adventure, Scavenger Hunt: ten penguins hidden around one place and found in any order is the preset's exact loop, and world-open plus the answer's walkable few-hundred-stud area keeps it a single compact surface on P0. The penguins are collectible-nodes with a stated count of ten, not npc-population, since they are the targets of the hunt rather than the inhabitants of the world. The escalating hint system is gameplay logic rather than geometry, so I promoted it to tracker-quest as the loaded option that gives objectives and progress somewhere physical to live. Decided without a user: no theme answer was needed beyond the stated North Pole, so the concealment is snowdrifts, ice ridges and pack-ice cover rather than buildings, which keeps building-interior and P3 off, and the completion message means no winner area to place.
